ANTHROPIC RAISES $81.3 BILLION IN RECORD BREAKING NASDAQ IPO DEBUT

Anthropic has completed a record-breaking $81.3 billion initial public offering on the Nasdaq, surpassing SpaceX's offering. The event highlights the massive scale of global investment currently flowing into artificial intelligence businesses.

For information only. Not investment advice.
